FN-S3JD75-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 254
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/01/2023
Senate Bill 254 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Department of
Examiners of Public Accounts by a small undetermined amount to conduct audits on athletic
associations in the State of Alabama.
